reading_rule: Rows are sampled single-crystal states; laboratory plotting segments retain separate fitted branches. No interpolation across temperatures or initializations is defined. Ratios compare to fitted populations, not independently measured uncertainties.

objective: Mean squared log mass/width/thickness ratios; equal weights per case, age and quantity. Speed is checked only.
selection: Minimum coarse training loss; no reserved measurements in the objective. Candidates must execute through the full requested horizon.

shape_budget.restriction: The inferred seed aspect ratio assumes the same initial envelope volume, freely changing its dimensions. It is a degeneracy demonstration, not a measured or adopted seed.

observed.evidence: Author digitization of Gonda and Yamazaki (1984), not new measurements.

author_model.evidence: Published model output, not an independent experiment or our model reproduction.

lateral_reference.scope: Confirms an observable facet-area transition at modest outer-size change. No facet-area predictions exist in the tested McSnow closures, so this is evidence for a missing observable, not their validation.
